# A session open whose cleanup did not settle leaves the command owning
# its open error and the job directory, which stays locked. No later
# command in the process reopens that job or opens a session for it, and
# a successful command for another job does not settle the owner.

skygo-ec2 start -config $CONFIG -state $STATE -credentials $CREDS -interval 0
code 0

openunsettled
! job run -job $WORK/job -task $WORK/task.json -workdir $WORK/src
code 1
stdout '"submit": "none"'
stderr 'cleanup did not settle'
stderr 'keeping the job directory locked'
opens 1
unsettled 1

ec2mark
! job resume -job $WORK/job
code 1
stderr 'locked by another process'
! job cancel -job $WORK/job
code 1
stderr 'locked by another process'
ec2since 0
opens 1
calls BeginArtifactUpload 0
jobs 0

job run -job $WORK/other -task $WORK/task.json -workdir $WORK/src -poll 100ms
code 0
stdout '"state": "SUCCEEDED"'
unsettled 1
opens 2

# The MODEL open held no connection, so the script settles the command.
release
unsettled 0
job resume -job $WORK/job -poll 100ms
code 0
stdout '"state": "SUCCEEDED"'
accepted BeginArtifactUpload 2
calls SubmitWorkspaceJob 2
opens 3
jobs 2

mutations 1

-- task.json --
{"argv":["/bin/true"],"timeoutSeconds":"60"}
-- src/input.txt --
input
